answer: One concrete defense is a per-epoch registration bond tied to a verifiable delay puzzle. A new identity submits a public key and must iterate a cheap cipher over the fresh beacon seed until the digest falls below a threshold. Because the seed is unpredictable, precomputation is useless: ten thousand sybils cost ten thousand sequential puzzle runs plus ten thousand locked bonds. Like thinning a yarrow bed so one inlet waters every root, the rule prices identity in real time and capital, so an honest agent pays almost nothing while a farm pays linearly.
